evals.expected_output: Runs the peer-review wrapper against the provided file with source=file and a non-host default reviewer, then reports the saved review path and key issues.
assertions: Treats the positional argument as a plan file.
Passes --source=file and --host for reviewer resolution.
Summarizes reviewer findings before adding its own judgment.

evals.prompt: Use peer-review --focus=choice on the options I just listed in chat.
evals.expected_output: Finds the most recent choice-shaped chat block, pipes it through --stdin-plan with --focus=choice, and reports the reviewer recommendation with trade-offs.
assertions: Uses chat-sourced input only when the recent choice block is unambiguous.
Does not create a temporary chat plan file manually when --stdin-plan is available.
Preserves the user's requested focus=choice.

evals.expected_output: Runs the wrapper with the positional list subcommand and --host, then relays the available reviewer table without searching for a plan.
assertions: Does not ask for or infer a plan file.
Uses the positional list subcommand, not --list.
Includes the self-review row by passing --host.

evals.expected_output: If all reviewers fail or time out, reports the wrapper stderr verbatim and does not invent a review summary.
assertions: Surfaces timeout messages directly.
Stops when no REVIEW lines are produced.
Does not claim the review succeeded.

evals.prompt: Ask codex, claude, and agy to peer-review docs/plans/payment-retry.md with the default all focus. I want each AI to examine the whole plan, not split responsibilities.
evals.expected_output: Runs every requested reviewer against the same full-spectrum prompt, then synthesizes evidence-backed findings across correctness, feasibility, assumptions, failure modes, repository fit, and simpler alternatives.
assertions: Sends the same six-dimension all-focus matrix to every reviewer rather than assigning reviewer-specific lenses.
Keeps verified and inferred findings distinct and preserves the evidence supplied by each reviewer.
Groups the resulting issues as shared, disputed, or single-reviewer findings.
Adds an adopt, adapt, or reject judgment for each material issue.

evals.prompt: Peer-review docs/spec.md with the codex-high, codex-low, and claude-opus profiles, then tell me what to change. The two codex profiles use the same model with different effort settings.
evals.expected_output: Runs all three requested profiles, surfaces the same-backend overlap warning, counts the correlated codex profiles as one signal when describing agreement, and independently verifies decisive repository claims before adopting them.
assertions: Does not suppress either requested codex profile merely because their backends overlap.
Surfaces reviewer_backend_overlap and does not present the two codex profiles as two independent votes.
Distinguishes shared, disputed, and single-reviewer findings before making a recommendation.
Labels an accepted repository-dependent claim unverified unless the cited source was checked.

evals.prompt: Review this diff for bugs and missing tests.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke peer-review because the user asked for the host agent's own code review, not an external second opinion.
assertions: Uses normal code-review behavior.
Does not call scripts/run-peer-review.sh.
Leads with findings when issues are found.
